description: Stormwater Channels is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. Approximate locations of existing channels in the stormwater system owned, operated and maintained by Pierce County PWU-Sewer and Water Utilities Division. Please read metadata ( for additional information. Any use or data download constitutes acceptance of the Terms of Use (. Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. The table has 26 columns. The portal shows 2024-07-05 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
